rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a specialised word or name for a concept.

example.english: This term is specifically used to describe quantum entanglement.
example.traditional: 呢個術語專門用嚟形容量子糾纏。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seot6 jyu5 zyun1 mun4 jung6 lai4 jing4 jung4 loeng6 zi2 gau2 cin4

rows.note: Use this for the binding conditions of a contract, including its payment conditions.

example.english: Before signing, you should read every term in the contract carefully.
example.traditional: 簽約之前，你要睇清楚合約入面每一項條款。
example.jyutping: cim1 joek3 zi1 cin4 nei5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 mui5 jat1 hong6 tiu4 fun2

rows.note: Use this for a limited period or the time limit within which something must happen.

example.english: The term for submitting the form runs until next Friday.
example.traditional: 份表格嘅提交期限去到下星期五。
example.jyutping: fan6 biu2 gaak3 ge3 tai4 gaau1 kei4 haan6 heoi3 dou3 haa6 sing1 kei4 ng5

rows.note: Use this specifically for one division of an academic year.

example.english: I have four subjects to take this term.
example.traditional: 呢個學期我有四科要讀。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 jau5 sei3 fo1 jiu3 duk6
